title: 3. When the Bill To is blocked
h2: 3. When the Bill To is blocked
note: Left to right: an invoiced work order, a work order holding a deposit, a Bill To on Credit Hold, Counter Sale, then phone. Before: production v26.45.2.1. After: the locked Bill To build. For the Credit Hold row, Valders was put on Credit Hold on both stacks for the shots and set back to COD after. After the tech review: clicking or tapping a locked Bill To shows its message as an error toast for anyone who can see the field; the button in the toast ("Open Deposits" or "Go To Invoice") shows only for users allowed to use it; history mode shows no lock message. The deposit row and the mary.moore row were reshot on the build after the review.
